description: Land Title Settlement Department - Chithragala, Hambantota D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830013
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration, declaring the determination of land ownership for specific parcels in Hambantota District. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications under the Registration of Title Act. This falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it concerns land registration, property ownership, and title settlement matters.
